scenes.desc: El cruce del thrash con la música industrial de baile: Godflesh, Fear Factory o Rammstein. En la frontera están Ministry y Nine Inch Nails, que quizá sean más bien música industrial metalizada.

podcast.title: The Matrix Soundtrack Contribution (1999)
podcast.body: Rammstein was featured on the first *Matrix* soundtrack, released in 1999. The album was characterized by "really cool heavy stuff," including contributions from other heavy acts like Marilyn Manson, Ministry, The Prodigy, and Rage Against the Machine. "It was some really cool heavy stuff, Marilyn Manson, Ministry of the Prodigy, Ramstein, Rage Against the Machine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Controversial Music Video and Sex Toy Line (2009)
podcast.body: In 2009, Rammstein released a music video featuring the band members, dressed in leather, engaging in sexually suggestive acts, interspersed with clips from six different porn films. Some scenes reportedly involved band members interacting with adult film stars, while others utilized body doubles. Their record company was "not amused" by the video's content. Rammstein is also one of over a dozen rock acts to have released their own line of sex toys. "In 2009, they released a clip, interspersed with the band, Dressed in Leather doing typical porn things, with clips from six different porn films."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Aggressive and Dark Style
podcast.body: The German band Rammstein is known for their very aggressive, unspoken, and dark musical style. "Ramstein, the German band, very aggressive, very unspoken, very dark."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Asteroid 110393 Ramstein
podcast.body: An asteroid, officially named 110393 Ramstein, has been designated in honor of the band Rammstein. This asteroid is about six kilometers in size, not very bright, and located somewhere between Mars and Jupiter. It was discovered by Jean-Claude Merlin at an observatory in Lucre-Sau, France. "The official name of their rock is 110393 Ramstein."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Frightening to Some
podcast.body: Rammstein is one of the bands that are considered frightening to some people. "Ramstein, Dillinger Escape Plan, Black Flag, and any number of hardcore bands were and are frightening to some people."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Most Dangerous Artists in Rock

podcast.title: High-Quality Physical Editions
podcast.body: The band is recognized for its consistently attractive and well-produced physical album editions, which often include elaborate packaging such as wooden boxes or special cases, large booklets, and posters. These editions are meticulously cared for and are not typically expensive, reinforcing their commitment to physical media. "las ediciones en formato físico de Ramstein siempre han sido especialmente chulas, tienen esas ediciones en cajas de madera, ediciones en cajas especiales que además tampoco son muy caras, pero que están super cuidadas con hibretos muy grandes, con posteles tienen, siempre han cuidado muchísimo en formato físico"

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan
srcs.episode: Artistas que no están en Spotify y por qué

podcast.title: Inspired by Skinny Puppy
podcast.body: Rammstein is explicitly listed as an artist who was inspired and influenced by the Canadian industrial band Skinny Puppy. "Here's a short list of artists who say they were inspired and influenced by Skinny Puppy, Ministry, Nine-inch Nails, Maryland Manson, the Prodigy, Ramstein, Filter, Corn, Lincoln Park, Evan Essence."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Preference for Physical Format
podcast.body: Rammstein strongly dislikes digital music supports and are significant proponents of physical formats. They actively encourage their fans to purchase albums at their concerts. "Ramstein odia este tipo también de soportes digitales, ellos son unos grandes amantes del formato físico, son gente que además en sus propios conciertos anima a la gente a comprar los discos"

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan
srcs.episode: Artistas que no están en Spotify y por qué

podcast.title: Techno Influences in Rock
podcast.body: Rammstein is presented as an example of a rock band that has been influenced by techno, demonstrating how techno's reach extends even to genres like rock. "No olvidemos a Rammstein."

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan
srcs.episode: De Madonna a las tiendas de ropa, el TECHNO está por todas partes
